rationale: Open Question 2 about @huggingface/transformers concurrency safety is unresolved and its answer would require adding lock mechanisms to scope if the library is not safe for concurrent writes.

signals.blast_radius: ~8 files in audio subsystem (cache-root, tts, align, models, commands, docs); first time the application writes outside the project directory
signals.unresolved: Whether @huggingface/transformers hub client is safe for concurrent writes into a machine-wide cache; if not, lockfile or wrapper enters scope
signals.irreversibility: Code is revertible via git; but users will populate machine-wide caches that become orphaned dependencies if the feature reverts
